instrument.title_ar: قرار وزير العمل رقم 250 لسنة 2026 بشأن قواعد ومعايير وبيان حدود الأمان في أماكن العمل والاشتراطات والاحتياطات اللازمة لدرء المخاطر

candidate_commencement.basis: The official Gazette catalogue metadata records publication on 2026-10-12. Article 2 in the secondary transcription states that the decision takes effect on the day following publication. The original Gazette pages have not been obtained or inspected; 2026-10-13 is therefore a candidate date only.

limitations: Catalogue metadata only; not the Gazette text itself.
No original file hash or page-level visual inspection.

supports: Ministry announcement that Decisions 248–252/2026 were issued as implementing measures under Labour Law 14/2025
limitations: Announcement does not replace the full Gazette instrument or certify its commencement clause.

supports: Secondary transcription of Decision 250/2026 including Article 2 commencement wording
limitations: Not an official Gazette copy; no original-PDF match performed; not sufficient to verify legal text or commencement date.

notes: The official catalogue entry establishes the existence and metadata of a Gazette supplement containing Decision 250/2026, but the underlying PDF remains unavailable through the ordinary download action.
The Ministry announcement is useful official context but does not authenticate the full text.
The 2026-10-13 commencement date is only an inference from catalogue publication metadata plus a secondary transcription of Article 2.
Do not enable retrieval or present the candidate commencement date as verified until the original Gazette pages are lawfully obtained, hashed, inspected and reconciled.
